title: release r26: add 62 occupational-health hazards from GBZ 188-2025 and the occupational-health management rule
head: data-verify-batch-003
body:
## Summary

- Ingested two in-force occupational-health sources into the verified clause library: GBZ 188-2025 (109 clauses) and the Worksite Occupational Health Management Rule (44 clauses).
- 168 auto-inversion candidates reviewed title-by-title in the main session: 62 applied (employer-duty items only), 106 dropped (clinic-procedure annexes, regulator duties, fragments).
- Pairing verified 62/62; gate six-phase PASS (1538 / 1917, strictBlockers=0), audit PASS, bundle verify clean; site-selection -> r26.
